formal_statement: Independent symmetric edge signs with mean parameter delta on the complete graph; decide whether high-probability global synchronization holds when delta >= (1+epsilon)*sqrt(log(n)/(2n)). See references/problem-boundaries.md for the recorded wording and source locator.
needed_lemma: A symmetric signed random-graph landscape certificate controlling every rank-two second-order critical point at the target small-bias scale, with a uniform-in-phase/configuration argument.
unproved_interface: McRae Theorem 3.2 gives a sufficient signed-ER regime but, at p=1 and small bias, its sufficient delta scale is about twice the C118 threshold (up to theorem slack); it does not resolve the threshold asked in C118. PGEL-002–008 and PGEL-010 concern positive undirected unit-edge models (PGEL-003/004 random graphs; PGEL-005/006 dense deterministic criteria; PGEL-007 positive-graph landscape results; PGEL-008 strict twisted-state stability only on symmetric positive circulants), so they do not map as evidence for the signed complete-graph threshold. No oriented-model transfer is justified. PGEL-009 adds an exact sparse circulant twisted-state instability example only (with Eq. (6) restricted to m>=2 and K2 handled separately); it does not rule out non-twisted equilibria. PGEL-011 is a positive high-dimensional sphere RGG landscape result, not a signed or fixed-low-dimensional theorem. PGEL-012 is a smooth-initial-data S2 scaling/synchronization route; its Eq. (2.6)/(2.8)/Lemma 3.7 heat-clock normalization remains unresolved, so quantitative diffusion reuse is withheld, and it is not an all-initial-data landscape result. PGEL-019 is a deterministic weighted undirected signed-Laplacian/cycle-space source; its unrestricted arXiv-v1 Theorem 2.6 and Theorem 2.8 sign identity are quarantined at exact triangle boundaries, while the stable negative-edge bound m_-<=C is an independent derivation only. PGEL-021 constructs stable equilibrium manifolds on explicit connected positive unweighted graphs; it is not a typical-graph probability theorem. PGEL-029 is an oriented signed deterministic source: its DAG sufficient result and single-cycle LaSalle result do not provide a random-signed complete-graph threshold. In the read v2, a legal signed 3-cycle quarantines Lemma 3.4 necessity and Proposition 3.6 exhaustive count; this does not reject its separate finiteness claim or establish facts about the unread journal version. PGEL-017, PGEL-018, and PGEL-032 add positive symmetric deterministic cycle, connected-planar, and connected-threshold-graph boundaries only; they are not C118 signed random-graph evidence and do not relax its model interface.

auxiliary_source_methods.scope: Equilibrium/stationarity only; not stability, identical trajectories of the complexified and original flows, or typical random-graph behavior.

auxiliary_source_methods.method: Generic BKK adjacency-polytope root count and exceptional symmetric-coupling analysis; use only isolated roots in (C*)^n and the exact source hypotheses.
auxiliary_source_methods.scope: Generic complex roots are not necessarily unit-torus phases, real equilibria, stable states, or local minima; no signed-law transfer.

auxiliary_source_methods.method: Conditional exact tree/cycle algebraic isolated-root method: adjacency-polytope normalized-volume upper bound; for stated exact tree/cycle classes, equality with the BI intersection index under the paper’s hypotheses, using a tree monomial map and cycle facet/Bernstein proof.

auxiliary_source_methods.method: A positive complete-graph baseline sharp bound for phase cohesion/frequency synchronization can serve as a deterministic comparison method when separating graph/energy hypotheses from synchronization conclusions.
auxiliary_source_methods.scope: C118 concerns random signed graph coupling and a threshold uniform over phase configurations. PGEL-030 assumes positive all-to-all coupling and arbitrary heterogeneous natural frequencies; it proves a robust phase-cohesion synchronization criterion, not a random signed Hessian certificate or absence of nonsynchronous local minima.

auxiliary_source_methods.method: A graphon/Fourier spectral calculation is a continuum-limit reference for distinguishing an operator-eigenvalue onset from a finite random-graph energy-landscape statement.
auxiliary_source_methods.scope: The self-adjoint graphon and smooth-even-frequency hypotheses are not the signed finite-n C118 model. Empirical-measure convergence and threshold formulas are cited background, and no bound uniform over phase configurations or finite-n signed-graph event follows.

auxiliary_source_methods.method: A continuum spectral-gap-to-local-stability method for a fixed twist, provided the limiting operator has a uniform strict Fourier gap over all nonzero modes; use the directly derived generator multiplier pi*lambda. For q>0, the printed uniform r,p rectangle is quarantined as a strict-gap certificate.
auxiliary_source_methods.scope: The theorem assumes an even L2 continuum kernel and a fixed twist with a proved all-mode strict gap. Its q>0 small-world statement cannot be transferred from the printed uniform r,p rectangle; only fixed sufficiently small r then p sufficiently small depending on r with full-gap verification is retained. No finite random signed-graph matrix, global-minimum, or probability-uniform-over-phase interface is proved.

auxiliary_source_methods.method: Symmetric Cayley finite-time Fourier/local variational criteria for twisted states, under the exact graph and spectral hypotheses.
auxiliary_source_methods.scope: The 2015 arXiv margin stamp and 2018 body date remain distinct. Lemma 7.3 counterexample is only for the doubly corrected intended-square interpretation. Th7.2/7.5 proof interface remains unverified; no uniform ER/time claim.

auxiliary_source_methods.method: Exact-equilibrium local Jacobian/weighted-Laplacian certificate from Eq. (9), for connected graphs with every edge cosine strictly positive.
